description: Instructions for Form 461 (2026, draft Sep 28, 2026), verbatim: 'A single filer with $400,000 of business losses and $50,000 of business income in 2026 would be: $400,000 − ($50,000 + $256,000) = $94,000 of excess business loss (disallowed).' Here: Schedule C loss $400,000, K-1 ordinary business income $50,000.
